audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart is shifted one row against both the packet data and its own explanations. Packet levelChart reads Warwick, Aurora, Skill, Skill, Warwick, Aurora, Aurora — and all seven whys describe exactly that. The stored sides read Aurora, Skill, Warwick, Warwick, Aurora, Warwick, Warwick, so six of seven rows show a side that contradicts the sentence printed beside it.
audit.why: whys[0] says 'Level 1 is yours' under a row labelled Aurora; whys[5] says 'At first item Aurora wins' under a row labelled Warwick. The prose and the packet agree with each other, so the sides are the corrupted layer.
audit.corrected: All seven rows in both layers set back to the packet chart, proposed as one atomic group, with ratings re-keyed to match. The whys then need no rewrite — they were right all along.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns given for Aurora's escape or her ultimate, and Primal Howl appears nowhere in the entry.
audit.why: Across the Veil is 22s at rank 1 — a long window against a champion whose whole plan is blinking away. Between Worlds is 140s at rank 1. Mirror finding: Primal Howl (2.5s damage reduction then a 1s fear) is the ability that most directly beats a poke-and-burst pattern and it is missing.
audit.corrected: 22s Across the Veil and Primal Howl's 2.5s/1s profile written into early; Between Worlds' 140s into phases[4].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: no Aurora ability is ever named. Two mechanical errors on top: 'Blood Hunt reveals her low' (Blood Hunt grants move speed toward and attack speed against sub-50% enemies — it grants no vision) and 'Infinite Duress is a point-and-click fight starter' (it is a directional leap that suppresses the first champion it collides with).
audit.why: Riot's W text has no reveal component; Riot's R text is a directional leap. The collision behaviour is the actual reason Across the Veil is a timing problem rather than a hard counter — she must blink before the leap, not during it.
audit.corrected: Across the Veil, Twofold Hex and Between Worlds named; the fake reveal replaced with Blood Hunt's real sub-50% trigger; R restated as a collision leap in spikes[1], phases[4].why and breakdown.late.

edits.before: Level 1 is yours with Q sustain, but Aurora's level-2 W dash and Q poke give her a real trading window — she can dodge your step and chip you, so play the wave and close distance carefully.
edits.after: Level 1 is yours with Q sustain, but Across the Veil at 22s and Twofold Hex hand her the level-2 window — hold Primal Howl for it: 2.5s of damage reduction, then a 1s fear on the way out.

edits.before: Your R Infinite Duress suppresses through her W dodge if you land it before she reacts — all-in at 6 when Blood Hunt reveals her low, since her ult zone doesn't save her from suppression.
edits.after: Infinite Duress collides with the first champion in its path, so Across the Veil only saves her if she blinks before you leap — all-in at 6 once Blood Hunt switches on under 50% health.

edits.before: Use Blood Hunt to chase her when she's revealed low
edits.after: Use Blood Hunt to sprint at her once she's under 50%

edits.before: Infinite Duress is a point-and-click fight starter that locks his carry tool. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Aurora's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Infinite Duress is a directional leap that suppresses the first champion it hits. Between Worlds is 140s at rank 1 — fight her while it is spent.

edits.before: Infinite Duress is a point-and-click fight starter that locks his carry tool — build your teamfight around that. Aurora carry threat: 8/10 — shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Infinite Duress is a directional leap that suppresses the first champion it collides with — build the fight around it. Aurora carry threat: 8/10 — shift to picks and wave control if she gets ahead.

edits.before: Q-bite Aurora as he steps up (hold Q to follow his dash), weave autos, and let the passive out-heal his return damage.
edits.after: Q-bite Aurora as she steps up (hold Q to follow Across the Veil), weave autos, and let Eternal Hunger heal you under 50%.

edits.before: Trading into his full burst window with E down — fear is your trade-flipper; without it you are just a sustain bot.
edits.after: Trading into her Q-E poke with Primal Howl down — that 1s fear is your trade-flipper; without it you are a sustain bot.

notes: The level chart here is shifted by exactly one row against the packet data, and all seven whys match the packet rather than the stored sides — so six of seven rows printed a side that contradicted the sentence next to it. Proposed the whole chart back to the packet as one atomic group; the prose then needed no touching. Worth checking other Warwick matchups for the same off-by-one, since the akshan entry shows a similar shape. Also removed another instance of the site-wide 'Blood Hunt reveals her' fabrication — Warwick's W grants no vision.
